pages.title: Lakeside Bench
atmosphere_notes: The approved summer anchor: calm water, tree shade, white T-shirt, and close everyday distance.
generation_notes: Preserve the relaxed seated posture.
Keep the image free of intentional writing.
Use this page as the mood standard for the rest of the booklet.

pages.title: Footbridge Breeze
atmosphere_notes: A breezy footbridge pause that keeps the summer shade while changing the silhouette and setting.
generation_notes: Bridge railings should read clearly as the scene anchor.
Hair and shirt movement can imply a light breeze.
Shoes and lower legs must remain connected and complete.

pages.title: Convenience Walk
atmosphere_notes: A bright summer errand scene that keeps the outfit simple and unbranded.
generation_notes: No package, sign, or store writing in the image.
Use bright pavement without harsh overexposure.
Keep the walking pose stable with visible feet.

pages.title: Dock Edge
atmosphere_notes: A calm dock-side composition that gives the booklet a stronger water-surface variation.
generation_notes: Let the open water and dock edge carry the composition.
Avoid making the scene read as another path walk.
Do not crop hair, hands, or shoes.

pages.title: Park Steps
atmosphere_notes: A seated park variation that tests grounded feet and relaxed knees.
generation_notes: Review seated anatomy before acceptance.
Ground both shoes with a clear shadow.
Keep the gray bottom and white T-shirt readable.

pages.title: Window Seat
atmosphere_notes: A quiet indoor summer page that changes light without changing the character core.
generation_notes: Use soft side light from the window.
Keep room props simple and free of writing.
White T-shirt remains the outfit anchor.

pages.title: Rain-Cooled Street
atmosphere_notes: A damp summer street scene that cools the palette while staying gentle.
generation_notes: Keep reflections subtle.
Avoid umbrellas, shop signs, and posters with writing.
A thin cardigan is allowed only if the white T-shirt still leads.

pages.title: Station After Sun
atmosphere_notes: A late-afternoon waiting scene with warm rim light and quiet transit context.
generation_notes: No station-name or timetable writing dependency.
Keep the waiting pose relaxed.
Use a thin outer layer only as a light variation.

pages.title: Vending Machine Night
atmosphere_notes: A quiet night page that swaps sunlight for practical cool light.
generation_notes: Vending details must remain unreadable as writing.
Balance cool light with warm skin tones.
Do not let machine graphics compete with Akari.

pages.title: Golden Hour Return
atmosphere_notes: A closing return-path scene with warm backlight and long shadows.
generation_notes: Keep outfit silhouette readable against sunset.
Use long shadows without hiding shoes.
Maintain the same calm everyday distance as the cover.
